## Overview

Accordion component for collapsible content sections

## Properties

| Property        | Attribute        | Description                                                                                           | Type                     | Default     |
| --------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------- |
| `allowMultiple` | `allow-multiple` | Whether multiple accordion items can be open at the same time                                         | `boolean`                | `false`     |
| `bordered`      | `bordered`       | Whether to show border around the accordion                                                           | `boolean`                | `false`     |
| `defaultOpen`   | `default-open`   | Index of the accordion item to open by default (0-based)                                              | `number`                 | `undefined` |
| `icon`          | `icon`           | Icon style for accordion items                                                                        | `"chevron" \| "plus"`    | `'chevron'` |
| `size`          | `size`           | Size of the accordion items — controls heading font size. sm = 14px, base = 16px (default), lg = 18px | `"base" \| "lg" \| "sm"` | `'base'`    |
